about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Norma J. Torres

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LIBERTY AND JUSTICE FOR ALL
statements.title: LIBERTY AND JUSTICE FOR ALL
sentences: We are witnessing a systematic deadly abuse of power by DHS, ICE, and Border Patrol.
In my home State of California, at the Adelanto facility, Carlitos Ricardo Parias, a man from Los Angeles held for months, filmed the filthy water detainees were forced to drink.
I am the mother of a law enforcement officer.
Congress cannot remain silent while the executive branch operates a deadly machine of abuse, intimidation, military grade weapons, and imprisonment.
When Members of Congress or Senators try to reduce deaths in custody and conduct oversight, they should never be met with lethal force.
One asylum seeker was subject to forced feeding for nearly 8 months.
ICE arrested him and took him to the Adelanto facility, a facility run by the GEO Group, a private prison company.
The government's response is: We are not going to address why you are protesting.
We are going to physically stop you from protesting.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STOP INSIDER TRADING ACT
statements.title: STOP INSIDER TRADING ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today to expose this package for what it truly is: a protection plan for powerful insiders disguised as a crackdown on insider trading.
The so-called Stop Insider Trading Act does not ban congressional stock trading.

Now, they have attached this watered-down stock trading bill to legislation that makes it even harder for Americans to vote, especially women in traditional marriages like mine where I changed my name and took on my husband's name.
The voter ID act eliminates trusted registration methods, restricts acceptable IDs, and creates unnecessary barriers between American citizens and the ballot box.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to vote ``no'' on this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NATIONAL SECURITY, DEPARTMENT OF STATE, AND RELATED PROGRAMS APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2027
statements.title: NATIONAL SECURITY, DEPARTMENT OF STATE, AND RELATED PROGRAMS APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2027
sentences: This agency funds local community-led programs in Latin America that keep young people out of drug cartels and gangs.
We cannot claim that we want to see a secure border and stop drug trafficking while simultaneously defunding the most cost-effective, proven programs that stop cartel recruitment at the source.
We are being asked for billions for the Iran war, but they want to close down the tools we have to stop conflicts before we are forced to send our young men and women in uniform into harm's way.
Cutting off food, clean water, and medicine during historic global instability is a guarantee for more regional chaos and health emergencies that eventually end up at our borders.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: WELCOMING CAPTAIN GLOVER HOME
statements.title: WELCOMING CAPTAIN GLOVER HOME
sentences: In 2023, Captain Glover was assigned to his most recent mission, Artemis II.
As Pilot, he launched from Kennedy Space Center on April 1, 2026, on a Space Launch System rocket alongside Reid Wiseman, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
The crew of Artemis II splashed down off the coast of San Diego on April 10, 2026, after venturing 252,756 miles from Earth.

Since then, he has received many other honors, including the Defense Superior Service Medal, Navy Commendation Medal, two Navy and Marine Corps Achievement Medals, NASA Distinguished Medal and NASA Space Exploration Medal, 2023 TIME 100 Next, Jet Magazine's inaugural 40 under 40, and Honorary Doctorates of Science from Howard University (2024) and California Polytechnic State University (2025).

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR DISPOSITION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 7147, DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR DISPOSITION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 7147, DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: It is a joke that we are being asked to hand a blank check to an agency that has turned into a regime secret police.
Stop the games, stop the sabotage, or get out of our way because we will win these elections, and we will take back America.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: VETERANS ACCESSIBILITY ADVISORY COMMITTEE ACT OF 2025
statements.title: VETERANS ACCESSIBILITY ADVISORY COMMITTEE ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, let's stop pretending the SAVE America Act is about election security because it is not.
This is a show-your- papers mandate to disqualify Americans who oppose their evil agenda.
Republicans know this and want to use that misinformation to block them from voting.
This bill would eliminate the voter registration methods that over 90 percent of Americans rely on, including online, mail-in, and DMV registration.
Zero noncitizens were found because election officials had already verified their eligibility.
Republicans call this voter ID.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to vote ``no'' on this attack on our democracy.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FIGHTING DHS IMMIGRATION RAIDS
statements.title: FIGHTING DHS IMMIGRATION RAIDS
sentences: Let me remind this Chamber, undocumented immigrants--the same people being targeted--contributed $96.7 billion in Federal, State, and local taxes in 2022, including $25.7 billion into Social Security benefits they will never receive, $6.4 billion into Medicare, $1.8 billion into unemployment insurance.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS AND EXTENSIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS AND EXTENSIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: Since Trump returned to office, Republicans have created an affordability nightmare, a mass transfer of hard-earned taxpayer dollars to billionaires.

Republicans shut down the government instead of finding bipartisan solutions to keep care affordable and took a 7-week paid hiatus, doubling healthcare costs for working families, cutting off food assistance right before Thanksgiving, and letting Trump spend his days pardoning insurrectionists, enriching billionaires, cozying up to dictators, and building himself a new ballroom, all while taking food away from families in need.
House Republicans should be here doing their jobs, not making life harder for working families.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in strong opposition of this deeply flawed bill because the American people deserve better.
Mr. Speaker, I urge a ``no'' vote.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I ask unanimous consent to amend the rule to make in order the amendment at the desk that protects against any cuts to Medicaid and SNAP.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: GOP TAX SCAM HURTS WOMEN AND FAMILIES
statements.title: GOP TAX SCAM HURTS WOMEN AND FAMILIES
sentences: Mr. Speaker, the Republican cuts to Medicaid jeopardize the lives of women and families across our country, women like Kristen from my district.
Despite these health concerns, Kristen works, volunteers in our community, and dreams of owning a bakery, thanks to Medicaid.
So that billionaires and big corporations can get even more handouts?
Protect Medicaid and the families who rely on Medicaid and got us to Congress. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: UNPRECEDENTED INFLUENCE
statements.title: UNPRECEDENTED INFLUENCE
sentences: The consequence of this unchecked power is a billionaire's unchecked ability to take earned services away from American families, distort markets for personal gain, and influence the future of American democracy.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: USAID FUNDING
statements.title: USAID FUNDING
sentences: I am alarmed by the illegal impoundment of Federal funding and the attempted destruction of USAID.
The administration's decision to close USAID is a direct violation of our Constitution and the law.
USAID is essential in stopping the flow of drugs, gangs, human trafficking, and migrants across our borders.
USAID's work is critical to combating criminal organizations and strengthening international partnerships with the FBI, DEA, and the Department of Justice.
Earlier this year, USAID's support was acknowledged as critical when top MS-13 leaders were arrested on terrorist charges.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PRIDE AND GRATITUDE FOR THE BRAVERY AND DEDICATION OF OUR 911 FIRST RESPONDERS AND FIREFIGHTERS
statements.title: PRIDE AND GRATITUDE FOR THE BRAVERY AND DEDICATION OF OUR 911 FIRST RESPONDERS AND FIREFIGHTERS
sentences: Mr. Speaker, as we continue to navigate these difficult times, I urge my colleagues to not play politics and ensure we provide the disaster relief aid that California deserves and needs now more than ever. ____________________
